title: PAO chief Persida Acosta defends Josh Aquino at launch of book ‘Laws of Life’
summary: Speaking at a book launch in Quezon City Thursday, PAO chief Persida Acosta said she sympathizes with Kris and Josh Aquino, as she also has a family member who's part of the PWD community.
